name: Futari wa Do M Iinchou!
source:
Due to his parents' circumstances, Seiji transfers to a new school. He's placed under the care of two committee members: Rino, the class representative, and Mizuki, the disciplinary committee chairperson.

One day, Seiji gets into an argument with Mizuki due to a misunderstanding and ends up hurling harsh words at her.

Overcome by his emotions, he lashes out at Rino, who tried to intervene, in the same manner. To his surprise, both Rino and Mizuki respond with unexpected words:

"Please... insult us more."

Curious about their strange behavior, Seiji decides to ask them what's going on. He soon discovers that they both have a masochistic side.

From that point on, Seiji begins engaging in various M-play scenarios with the two of them...

translation:
由于父母的情况，诚司转学到了新学校。他受到两名委员的照顾：班级代表里诺和风纪委员会主席水树。

某日，诚司因误会与瑞希发生争执，并恶言相向。

情绪激动的他也以同样的方式对试图干预的里诺进行了猛烈的攻击。令他惊讶的是，里诺和水树都用出人意料的话语回应道：

“请……再侮辱我们一点。”

诚司对他们的奇怪行为感到好奇，决定询问他们发生了什么事。他很快发现他们都有受虐狂的一面。

从那时起，Seiji开始与他们两个一起参与各种M-play场景……
